qualified: Borrowed local positional TIFF, classic/BigTIFF, planar/chunky, selected children/regions and exact samples, stable owned-file cursor isolation.
Resident JXL presentations and raw layers preserve native samples and ownership; nonresident source refuses before reads.
Wrong composition and foreign cursor refusals; discovery allowance; first matching factory failure never falls back.
Inherited limits or decode policy are passed to native factories, which explicitly refuse their unqualified mapping before I/O.
Inherited pulse cancellation, inherited stop and per-call stop remain effective before opening, after registry drop and in publication callbacks, for Cancelled and TimedOut.
Original source/application/native causes and traces survive; publication is refused after conditional HTTP source replacement or truncation.
The guide uses the real CodecSet and shared CollectionFactory; duplicate private registry and erasure implementations are removed.
remaining: Native adapter packaging in codec crates.
Qualified enforcement mappings for all supplied legacy limits and decode policies; current native factories refuse them.
Progress reporting, automatic format detection and transferable opened jobs.
Fallible small factory/cursor boxes, native workspace admission and whole-container privacy scope.
No accepted speed or erasure-cost comparison.
